description: A soldier in a khaki slouch hat with a feather and a khaki tunic with a cartridge bandolier rides a galloping bay horse, holding a drawn bladed weapon forward. Behind him other mounted men in similar hats ride through dust and smoke under a dark stormy sky. On the right, a trench line with figures and gunfire flashes, and smoke rises from the ground. No text, numbers, frame or border; the painting fills the image edge to edge. Nothing gory. Early twentieth-century military dress and equipment.
